craft_notes: Sthāyin: actor-partless (states as rays). Rows: row 2 (beam→fact). Close: fact (tattvataḥ as landing: IN TRUTH). Rejected: 'dream states are unreal' — killed: held-as-rays kept (dhārayan as holding, not dismissing); smoothing print naTavan — kept actor (sense kept; print byte in L0).

lines: Wake-world, dream, deep sleep, and the rest — held as rays of yours;
by own will you beam like an actor, yet partless in fact.
l4.sanskrit_cite: jāgratasvapnasuṣuptyādyā dhārayaṃśca nijāḥ kalāḥ | svecchayā bhāsi naṭavan niṣkalo'si ca tattvataḥḥ

reads_against.argmap: Who shines like an actor yet stays partless? → States held as own rays: shining by own will like an actor, yet partless in truth.
